notes.title: Patch Notes: Labyrinth of Zangetsu Bug fixes (2023/05/22)
notes.notes:
Good Morrow Adventurer, our deepest gratitude for your continued service to Zangetsu.

We come to you today with some Patch and Bug fixes to further aid your quests and ventures.

Here are the fixes:

· Crashes involving teleporter have now been vanquished.
· Maps on the camp screens have been restored.
· Background textures have been sent to their proper place.
· Thanks to the wonderful community of players several other smaller bugs have also been fixed as well as some text has been corrected.

We are still working to amend some issues regarding text and a surprise attack, thank you for your patience.

notes.title: About bug fixes
notes.notes:
We have fixed the issue where the save function was not working in non-English European language environments.
Additionally, we have also addressed the bug where enemy characters were not displaying correctly.
We will continue to work on addressing these issues in the future.

notes.title: About bug fixes(2023/4/20)
notes.notes: We have confirmed an issue where the UI and enemy character display may become distorted when using a high-resolution monitor. However, we have now addressed this issue with a fix, and the problem has been resolved.
